content: ⌊ DRAFT g The Os Low Proxy shall provide a basic service implementation for the following APIs, to be used and connected with an Applica- tive Software Cluster : • GetResource • ReleaseResource • SuspendOSInterrupts • ResumeOSInterrupts • ReleaseResource • GetSpinlock • ReleaseSpinlock • GetApplicationID These APIs shall be provided with a corresponding service resource from SwClu- COsProxy .
